workflow: A view-like object creates a derived view that retains a pointer into shared backing storage before fully resolving slice bounds.
Resolving a user-controlled slice bound invokes callback code that releases or truncates the underlying storage.
The derived view keeps the stale pointer after its owner invalidates the backing storage.
A later access through the derived view dereferences the invalid storage and terminates instead of reporting a recoverable error.
summary: Reentrant backing-storage release leaves a derived view with a dangling pointer
decision_reason: The failure is materially the same as retaining a pointer into storage after its owner releases or invalidates the buffer, with reentrant slice-bound evaluation providing the trigger.
